there is a significant positive relationship between leadership and personality dimensions.
The results show that there is a significant relationship between personality traits and leadership styles.

(a) transformational, charismatic, and servant leadership are positively related to extraversion and agreeableness, (b) transformational leadership is negatively related to neuroticism, (c) transactional leadership is positively related to conscientiousness, and (d) laissez-faire leadership is negatively related with agreeableness
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: (i) developing a representative model of leadership styles, (ii) exploring the link between personality and leadership styles and (iii) exploring the link of representative leadership styles to personality.
the following research question: How do the big five personality dimensions predict the representative styles of leadership?
the following question: What is the link between leadership style and personality?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the personality traits of openness, conscientiousness, and extraversion are positively related to transformational leadership style.
the personality of a leader is a significant factor in determining the leadership style of the leader.
leadership styles are not personality traits but they are a product of the interaction of personality traits.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the five representative styles of leadership are: 1) Transformational, 2) Transactional, 3) Laissez-faire, 4) Authoritarian, and 5) Democratic.
leadership styles can be represented by five representative styles, and each of these styles is related to specific personality dimensions in a unique way.

there is no significant relationship of any personality dimension with any representative leadership style except that of extraversion with transformational leadership style and conscientiousness with autocratic leadership style.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a significant positive correlation of all representative styles with extraversion and agreeableness.
there is a strong relationship between leadership style and personality traits.
the relationship between leadership style and personality dimensions are not as clear cut and linear as it is often perceived.
